          Playback
          YouTube Music
          Checking for yt-dlp...
          About YouTube Music
          Playing needs yt-dlp, which finds each song's audio, and Deno, which runs YouTube's player code for it. The first time YouTube Music is on, OmniPulse downloads both from their official GitHub releases into its own folder (about 58 MB), each checked against the checksum published with it, and yt-dlp updates itself once a day after that. Their caches stay in that folder too, so Remove takes everything off this PC. A yt-dlp or Deno you've installed yourself is used if OmniPulse doesn't have its own. Switching YouTube Music off stops it being used anywhere.
          Nothing signs in: search, radio and playing work without a Google account, and likes are kept on this PC.
